sources.name: VSPORTS — Liga Portugal video evidence
sources.notes: Match-event/video evidence used to identify candidate incidents. Video evidence alone does not settle interpretative refereeing questions.

sources.name: Verdade Desportiva
sources.notes: Aggregates match incidents and cites named referee analysts. Used as traceability/sanity source, not as a substitute for expert consensus.

rule: Confirmed public errors require the evidence threshold in README/validate.py. Aggregator, specialist media, video evidence or fan/editorial material alone never confirms an interpretative error.
